podcast.body: This song is featured on Captain Beefheart's 1969 album, "Trout Mask Replica." It is presented as an example of the album's deliberately strange and challenging sound. "From Trout Mask Replica, this is Captain Befart and Frownland."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song is featured on Captain Beefheart's double album *Trout Mask Replica* from 1969. It is notable for its intentionally designed unconventional sound, reflecting Beefheart's experimental artistic approach. The deliberate sonic choices in "Frownland" exemplify the disagreeable yet critically acclaimed style that defined *Trout Mask Replica*. "This song sounds this way on purpose."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track from the 1969 album *Trout Mask Replica* is intentionally designed to sound unconventional and challenging, signifying a deliberate artistic choice rather than a technical flaw. "This song sounds this way on purpose."
